Pinned TypeScript 7.1 tsgo output, generated by target/typescript7/bin/tsc.
P and R are supplied handover fixtures, byte-identical to expected-tsgo-maps.
S is a neighboring constructor/method default case. Full emit uses declaration, declarationMap and sourceMap; declaration-only adds emitDeclarationOnly.
Options: es2024, nodenext, experimentalDecorators, useDefineForClassFields=false, strict; package type=module; outDir=out.
The generated file names and relative source paths are independent of the physical output-directory name.

W/X/Y/Z pin note20: moved field + defaulted parameter property, no-field, plain-parameter and no-default controls. Each has all four output kinds in assign/define at both useDefineForClassFields values. These use es2024/nodenext, experimentalDecorators, noLib/noResolve and package type=commonjs, without strict. The pinned binary exits 2 for missing global types but emits all four outputs. W assignment-mode mappings exactly equal the note20 tsgo reproduction.
